item.title: Fourier Transform Brachiosaurus - Math Dinosaur T-Shirt
item.description: This design was created using a custom-coded application programmed to trace the Brachiosaurus outline using Fourier transform math. Rather than a standard text-to-image AI generation, this piece features authentic mathematical plotting, with the body details filled in using the actual FFT equations from the process.
